prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Upload Photos Screen: Redesign the photo upload screen using a visual card layout to streamline companion photo submission.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Upload Pet Photos", "body": "Select clear photos of your pet to generate their custom desktop avatar."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] New Pet Bio Preview Screen: Insert a new screen after the adoption certificate where users preview and customize their pet's bio and personality tags.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_pet_bio_preview", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_bio_preview": {"headline": "Pet Personality & Bio", "body": "Review your pet's traits before bringing them to life on your desktop.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Confirm & Proceed"}}
2: [finish, redesign] Checklist Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a checklist layout confirming desktop permissions, companion launch status, and controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Desktop Pet Ready Checklist", "body": "Confirm your desktop setup steps below to launch your companion smoothly."}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] New Companion Trait Selection Flow: Introduce a new trait selection screen right before path selection to help users define their pet companion style.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_trait_selection", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_selection": {"headline": "Choose Companion Trait", "body": "Select how you would like your desktop companion to interact with you throughout the day.", "layout": "stage", "button_label": "Continue to Paths"}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Data Persistence Copy: Update sign-in copy to explicitly highlight that signing in saves your pet permanently and prevents pet reset issues.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save & Sync Your Pet Forever", "body": "Sign in now to lock in your pet's memory, customization, and progress securely."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Display Generation Progress Bar on Waiting Screen: Enable progress bar and remaining time estimate on the waiting screen during pet creation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We are assembling your custom pet. Please hold on a moment."}}
6: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Companion Preview Hint: Add a reassuring hint component on the Pick Friend screen clarifying that pet traits can be adjusted anytime later.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can customize your pet's appearance and behavior later in settings."}}
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Toggle on Home Intro Screen: Enable background notify when ready toggle on the home intro screen so users are alerted when the pet completes desktop spawning.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Get notified on your desktop as soon as your pet companion is active."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Stage Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen: Change the layout of the Choose Path screen to stage layout for a prominent view of available companion paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Select Your Journey", "body": "Choose how your pet companion fits into your daily desktop routine."}}
9: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Sync Mascot Hint: Add a mascot hint component on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in backs up their pet safely to the cloud.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your desktop pet data is safely backed up and never lost."}}

verdicts.reason: The card layout redesign keeps the photo upload functionality intact without violating any base rules.
Adding a bio preview screen inside onboarding retains all required steps and complies with onboarding customization rules.
Redesigning the home intro screen into a checklist layout is allowed within onboarding bounds.
Inserting a trait selection screen into the onboarding flow preserves all mandatory steps and rules.
Updating sign-in copy to emphasize account data persistence is valid and fair design.
Displaying a progress bar and time estimate during a real generation wait is permitted under Rule 5.
Adding a helpful customization hint on the Pick Friend screen is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a desktop notification toggle to the home intro screen is permitted as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Changing the layout of the Choose Path screen while preserving its core functionality complies with all base rules.
Adding a mascot hint reassuring users about data backup on sign-in is allowed.
